name: Alli AI
summary: Agency-grade SEO automation — bulk on-page optimizations, rules and keyword tracking across multiple sites and CMSes from one dashboard.
best_for: consultants and agencies managing SEO across a portfolio of client sites who want bulk on-page changes, optimization rules and keyword tracking from one dashboard
skip_if: you run a single site — $299 buys far more capacity than you need, and a one-site SEO suite costs a fraction — or you're not comfortable letting software edit pages in bulk
honest_knock: The entry is $299 a month paid monthly — agency-grade automation priced accordingly — and every tier meters on FOUR axes at once (sites, seats, keywords, pages). Growth on any axis costs extra, though at least the rates are published: from $39 per extra site, $24.99 per 100 extra keywords and $14.99 per 250 extra pages on monthly Business. And the category caveat an honest review owes you: bulk automated on-page edits are powerful, but changes at scale deserve human review — unchecked automated SEO is how sites break. One more thing the pricing page does not answer, and it matters at $299 a month: their own FAQ says your site, CMS and code stay untouched, so where changes are delivered through that snippet they last exactly as long as the subscription does. Price this as renting an improvement, not buying one, and ask them directly what happens to applied changes after you cancel before you commit a year.

pricing.notes: (prices re-verified 2026-09-19 on alliai.com/pricing) Billed in USD, no free tier, a 10-day free trial on every plan and cancellation from the dashboard at any time. The page shows two ladders behind a Monthly/Annual toggle. Paid monthly: Business $299 a month (5 sites, 5 team members, 500 keywords, 1,250 pages) and Agency $599 a month (15 sites, 15 team members, 2,000 keywords, 5,000 pages). Paid annually: Business $2,990 a year and Agency $5,990 a year, which the page prints as $249 and $499 a month, a saving of $598 and $1,198 respectively. Enterprise is quote-only (50 sites, 50 team members, 5,000 keywords, 20,000 pages). Every quota has a published add-on price that differs per tier and per term: monthly Business is extra sites from $39 each, extra keywords from $24.99 per 100 and extra pages from $14.99 per 250; annual Business $32.50, $20.83 and $12.50; monthly Agency $29, $14.99 and $9.99; annual Agency $24.17, $12.50 and $8.33. Business and Agency carry the same engine — the AI Search Visibility Engine, pre-rendering for 50-plus AI crawlers, the AI bot traffic monitor, LLM Mode, keyword tracking, site speed optimizer, link builder, standard reports and a weekly crawl — and Agency adds only API access, white label and snippet hosting.
